The thickness of the film obtained by XRR measurements (Figure S2a, Supporting Information) was 22 nm, therefore a growth per cycle (GPC) of 0.11 nm follows. The root mean square (RMS) roughness extracted from the AFM images was around 0.40 nm. The RMS roughness of the bare Si wafer substrate used in this work was 0.20 nm. Hence, the roughness of the deposited film is lower or equal to previous results reported for different ALD processes.
